blocks.html:
Nusens Vinyl Car Wrap

Nusens dropped off their latest addition to their ever-growing fleet to be wrapped. Nusens wanted a car wrap of their logo onto the Hyundai Kona car. The Proof shows what the client’s design is and that they approved. Our installation team then uses this to apply the decals to the Kona.

Installation of Vinyl during Winter

Toronto roads are covered in salt and dirt as we head into January. Our installation crew has had to spend time cleaning and preparing the Hyundai Kona before we can start the car wrap. Depending on the level of detail and coverage of the wrap, a job can take between 2 to 4 hours to install. This time of course does not consider the amount of preparation time our in-house graphics team spends ensuring the logos are clear and convey the right message. We here at Vinyl Wrap Toronto print and cut all the vinyl on-site in Etobicoke. This Nusens Kona car wrap was done using Avery Dennison wrap. The Weeding of the vinyl is a simple task for most vinyl wrap jobs, but this graphic design took a little longer.

The design called for a splatter effect which the client loves and makes a statement. Have a look at another splatter effect vehicle we did recently for a client who wanted to celebrate the Raptors winning the NBA Championship, click here. We here at Vinyl Wrap Toronto want your wrap to stand out and make the vehicle recognizable. We offer recreational, personal, and business wraps. If you own a muscle car or just love cars as much as we do. Speak to us about adding a punisher logo or add stripes to your pride and joy. Call our graphics and installation team at 416-746-1381. They can assist you with colour options, materials, finishes, and prices.
